Server

Auto-reconnect

Stops permanently on rejected credentials (auth errors are not retried).

Upstream proxy

Routes the outer transport of every session of this profile through the proxy: HTTP CONNECT or SOCKS5 to reach the SSTP server, with optional credentials. Leave as None for a direct connection.

Tunnels

Opens this many parallel SSTP sessions (each with its own inner IP). Concurrent flows are spread across them for aggregate throughput, and each session redials on its own if it drops. 1 = classic single session.
